title: Fix V2 Auth Modal Mounting, 2-Role Sign-In (Founder vs Student), and Google Avatar Hydration
objective: Mount AuthModal in V2AppShell to resolve unresponsive login/signup buttons on mobile/desktop, enforce strict 2-role system (Founder for mdtanvirkabirbiplob@gmail.com, Student for all others), and fix Google profile image hydration across client and server.
in_scope: Mount AuthModal in V2AppShell and wire openAuthModal triggers across V2Header (desktop & mobile drawer) and V2DashboardPage
Add mobile-friendly Login/Sign-up button inside V2Header mobile drawer when unauthenticated
Enforce strict 2-role assignment: mdtanvirkabirbiplob@gmail.com strictly gets role 'founder'; all other emails strictly get role 'student'
Fix Google avatar photo hydration in server (server/routes/auth.ts, server/authHelper.ts), AuthContext, and render in V2Header and V2DashboardPage
Create and run automated test suite (scripts/test-v2-auth-and-roles.ts) and headless browser verification ensuring modal opens and sign-in succeeds
out_of_scope: Modifying payment gateway billing keys or third-party OAuth provider secrets
Altering production database schema or deleting live learner records
Redesigning exam engine marksheets or CV PDF export (scheduled for subsequent work packages)
acceptance_criteria: Clicking Login / Sign-up button on desktop or mobile in Version 2 immediately opens the Supabase/Google authentication modal
Mobile hamburger drawer displays clean Login / Sign-up action for unauthenticated users
mdtanvirkabirbiplob@gmail.com automatically acquires role 'founder' with immediate access to Founder Cockpit; all other users acquire role 'student'
Google account profile picture renders cleanly in V2Header and dashboard dropdown upon login
npm run build passes with 0 errors and automated test suite passes 100%
risks: Google image URLs from googleusercontent.com might need referrer-policy='no-referrer' to avoid cross-origin image block. Mitigation: Set referrerPolicy='no-referrer' on avatar images.
